comments.author: Amuroray
comments.body:
Hi i'm wondering if there is a list of chronoquest somewhere ? or the chronoquest is random ?

i'm looking for the 1st of 16th century and and the 4th of 15 century , any1 can help ? thx

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Hi there. While no English translated list of Chrono quests exists on this DB or elsewhere that I know of (a future project to work on, fellow UWO lovers?), you can find a Japanese listing of Chrono quests here:

gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?Quest/ChronoQuest

Note that the quests are never random -- the same ones will always give the same Chrono era title. But of course, not all quests are Chrono Quests. Hope you find what you're looking for. Cheers.
